title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Saverona Elementary School in Barangay Saverona, Municipality of Talugtug, Province of Nueva Ecija to Alberto G. Bautista Elementary School

text.en: Renaming of an Elementary School. – The name of Saverona Elementary School in Barangay Saverona, Municipality of Talugtug, Province of Nueva Ecija is hereby changed to Alberto G. Bautista Elementary School.

Location of the Main Campus. – The main campus of the Alberto G. Bautista Elementary School shall continue to remain in its present location in Barangay Saverona, Municipality of Talugtug, Province of Nueva Ecija.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
